claims: The 'godfather of vibe coding' (Andrej Karpathy, photo shown) called out the problems of Claude Code
Repo has 216,000 stars (transcript; not visible on screen)

Four problems: (1) Claude makes assumptions without asking and hides confusion; (2) overcomplicates and leaves dead code, '1,000 extra lines of spaghetti'; (3) change one thing, breaks three unrelated things; (4) power users create loops instead of tasks -- give Claude a goal and let it loop until reached
how_to_steps: Go to the GitHub repo multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
Copy the URL into Claude and ask it to help you install
Use the resulting skills to make Claude ask before assuming, keep edits minimal/orthogonal, and work in verifiable loops
on_screen_only: Photo of Andrej Karpathy (unnamed in transcript)

Caption cards: 'Wrong assumptions, hidden confusion, missing tradeoffs' / 'Overcomplication, bloated abstractions' / 'Orthogonal edits, touching code you shouldn't' / 'Leverage through tests-first, verifiable success criteria'
cta: Try it out and let me know what you build; follow for more

relevance.why: The four failure modes are exactly what a solo founder hits daily in Claude Code; a CLAUDE.md/skill that enforces 'ask before assuming, minimal diff, tests-first, loop to verifiable criteria' is high leverage.

implement_score.why: Low effort: read the repo's SKILL.md, pull the useful rules into our own CLAUDE.md or a skill rather than installing blindly. The underlying principles are sound regardless of star count.
